vienna-eastern-alps-ges-use-national-par.slogan: A 620 km loop out of Gesäuse National Park Weekend
vienna-eastern-alps-ges-use-national-par.story: Built for flow, views and useful stops rather than navigation busywork. A 620 km loop that starts and ends near Neusiedl am See, about 11 h 29 of riding. On the way it passes Scenic stretch near Gutenstein, near Spitz and near Čejkovice. in Wiesmath is the high point. It tops out at about 800 m. It crosses Austria, Czechia and Slovakia - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules.

sections.from: Fuel stop near Neusiedl am See

sections.advice: This High point in Wiesmath → Scenic stretch near Gutenstein stretch is for rhythm and scenery. Keep your head up, let the view breathe, and resist turning every open bend into a target. Stop once properly rather than half-stopping everywhere.

Scenic stretch near Gutenstein → Photo stop near Spitz is the technical section. Hairpins, gradients and mixed traffic can stack up quickly; use low drama inputs, stay wide of centre lines and expect buses or riders appearing exactly where optimism says they will not.

This Photo stop near Spitz → Food stop near Čejkovice stretch is for rhythm and scenery. Keep your head up, let the view breathe, and resist turning every open bend into a target. Stop once properly rather than half-stopping everywhere.

Food stop near Čejkovice → Skalica, on the way back can flow quickly, but only if you keep village limits and junction sightlines sacred. Fast connectors are where rides get untidy when fatigue creeps in.

safetyMarkers.note: Respect posted limits and assume enforcement near villages, viewpoints and main-road joins.
